preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 200000 for n in [n_val for n_val in []])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 2*10^5 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.
Each test case provides n-1 edges forming a valid tree (undirected, connected, n nodes, n-1 edges) with node labels 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(map(int, line.split())) == list(range(1, n_i + 1)) for i, line in enumerate(output_lines) for n_i in [n_values[i]])
postconditions.description: Each output line is a permutation of integers from 1 to n for the corresponding test case.

The provided permutation maximizes the count of starting nodes from which Eikooc (the first player) has a winning strategy under the game rules: moves must be to an unvisited adjacent node u where u XOR v <= min(u, v).
